chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Paris, 2024, the Olympics: USA against Japan, in extra time. Crystal Dunn hits a long pass to Trinity Rodman on the right. She races at the defender... cuts inside... left foot... what a goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Rodman attacks Hikaru Kitagawa at full speed, then cuts the ball back inside. The defender is beaten.

chapters.label: Top corner
chapters.text: Her left foot fires it over the diving keeper, into the top corner. The USA went on to win gold!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: attack the defender at speed, and be brave enough to try a trick.
